segments.name: North America
segments.description: Manufactures and sells wood and concrete structural connectors, fasteners and anchors to lumber dealers, home centers and contractors in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: The North America segment includes operations primarily in the U.S. and Canada.

segments.name: Europe
segments.description: Sells wood and concrete construction products such as connectors, fasteners, anchors and mass timber solutions to residential, commercial and OEM customers across Europe.
segments.evidence: The Europe segment includes operations primarily in France, the United Kingdom, Germany, Denmark, Switzerland, Portugal, Poland, The Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Sweden, Norway, and Italy.

segments.name: Asia/Pacific
segments.description: Distributes connectors, anchors and adhesive products to customers in Australia, New Zealand, China, Taiwan and Vietnam.
segments.evidence: The Asia/Pacific segment includes operations primarily in Australia, New Zealand, China, Taiwan, and Vietnam.

revenueModel.text: Lumber dealers, home centers, component manufacturers, OEMs, distributors and contractors pay for structural connectors, fasteners, anchors and related software and engineering services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells a significant portion of its products directly to lumber dealers and building materials cooperatives that serve residential and light commercial construction markets.
